Headline CPI came in at 1.9% year on year, flat versus July and below the 2.0% expected, while core CPI printed at 1.7%, down from July's 1.8% and short of the 1.8% forecast.

The core-core measure also came in at 1.7%, well below the 2.0% expected.

The softer print prompted a modest weakening in the yen, as it raised doubts over how hawkish the Bank's outlook would be even with a rate hike still widely priced.
